claims.claim_en: The parallelism between 'you will surely believe in it and you will surely support it' constitutes a muqabalah (pairing/parallelism) that reinforces the covenantal commitment, repeating both belief and active support for rhetorical emphasis.
claims.needs_review_reason: Support comes from a tafsir remark noting exhortation ('وفيه ترغيب في الطاعة') rather than an explicit theoretical discussion of muqabalah; confirm with specialized balagha commentary (al-Jurjani/al-Sakkaki) for exact device labeling.
claims.rhetorical_effect: strengthens the promise by pairing inward conviction with outward action, producing emphatic, covenantal resonance
